title: Epigenetic Reprogramming of Refractory Glioblastoma via Synthetic microRNA Nanoparticles
abstract: Proposes a non-standard direct epigenetic silencing method for treatment-resistant brain tumors. High initial panel disagreement between conservative oncologists and synthetic biologists. Ideal test candidate for the 5% exploration audit and VOI allocation.

title: High-Throughput Recombinant Antigen Screening for Broad-Spectrum Coronaviruses
abstract: Standard multi-epitope assay using established laboratory robotics. Highly predictable outcomes, low variance, top 8th percentile priority. Fast-passed without redundant review triage.

title: Room-Temperature Optically Pumped Magnetometry for Non-Invasive Cardiac Mapping
historical_funding_outcome: Unfunded (Later Led to Major Clinical Spinout)
abstract: Just missed the standard payline (22nd percentile vs 16th cutoff) due to high initial skepticism regarding magnetic shielding noise. Testing how randomized exploration audits (H_hat_D) capture overlooked breakthroughs.
